build_gaussian_heatmap: build a 2D Gaussian kernel with configurable shape and sigma for heatmap generation
draw_gaussian_on_heatmap: draw a Gaussian blob centered at a given point on an existing heatmap array
compute_gaussian_radius: compute the optimal Gaussian radius for a detection box given a minimum overlap threshold
extract_polar_mask: extract 36 polar distance coordinates and center point from a binary mask contour
decode_ctdet_predictions: decode center-based detection heatmap outputs into masks, bounding boxes, and optional pose estimates
